name: ballerina/time
description: This module provides a set of APIs that have the capabilities to generate and manipulate UTC and localized time.

typeDefs.name: Utc
typeDefs.description:
Point on UTC time-scale.
This is represented by a tuple of length 2.
The tuple is an ordered type and so the values can be
compared using the Ballerina <, <=, >, >= operators.
The first member of the tuple is int representing an integral number of
seconds from the epoch.
Epoch is the traditional UNIX epoch of `1970-01-01T00:00:00Z`.
The second member of the tuple is a decimal giving the fraction of
a second.
For times before the epoch, n is negative and f is
non-negative. In other words, the UTC time represented
is on or after the second specified by n.
Leap seconds are handled as follows. The first member
of the tuple ignores leap seconds: it assumes that every day
has 86400 seconds. The second member of the tuple is >= 0.
and is < 1 except during positive leaps seconds in which it
is >= 1 and < 2. So given a tuple [n,f] after the epoch,
n / 86400 gives the day number, and (n % 86400) + f gives the
time in seconds since midnight UTC (for which the limit is
86401 on day with a positive leap second).

typeDefs.name: DayOfWeek
typeDefs.description: Day of the week according to the US convention, starting on Sunday.

typeDefs.name: Date
typeDefs.description: A date in the proleptic Gregorian calendar.

typeDefs.name: ZoneOffset
typeDefs.description:
Time zone offset.

Constraints:
- If any of the fields (`hours`, `minutes`, `seconds`) are > 0, then all must be >= 0.
- If any of the fields are < 0, then all must be <= 0.

typeDefs.name: TimeOfDay
typeDefs.description:
Time within a day.
Not always as a duration from midnight.

typeDefs.name: ZERO_OR_ONE
typeDefs.description: Type that can be either zero or one.

typeDefs.name: Civil
typeDefs.description: Time within a region relative to a time scale stipulated by civilian authorities.

fields.name: timeAbbrev
which
fields.description:
when the clocks are put back at the end of DST,
one hour's worth of times occur twice
i.e. the local time is ambiguous
this says which of those two times is meant
same as fold field in Python
see https://www.python.org/dev/peps/pep-0495/
is_dst has similar role in struct tm,
but with confusing semantics

fields.name: dayOfWeek

typeDefs.name: UtcZoneHandling
typeDefs.description: Default zone value in different formats.

typeDefs.name: Duration
typeDefs.description:
Time duration used to adjust a civil date-time value by a specified amount.
The duration can be added to or subtracted from the civil time.
Fields in the record can be negative, in which case the duration is subtracted.

typeDefs.name: HeaderZoneHandling
typeDefs.description: Indicates how to handle both `zoneOffset` and `timeAbbrev`.

typeDefs.name: Zone
typeDefs.description: Abstract object representation to handle time zones.

typeDefs.name: TimeZone
typeDefs.description: Initializes a `TimeZone` object using a zone ID or the system default time zone.

functions.name: utcNow
functions.description:
Returns the `time:Utc` representing the current time (current instant of the system clock in seconds from the epoch of `1970-01-01T00:00:00`).
```ballerina
time:Utc utc = time:utcNow();
```

parameters.name: precision
parameters.description:
Specifies the number of zeros after the decimal point (e.g., 3 would give the millisecond precision
and nil means native precision (nanosecond precision 9) of the clock)

return.description: The `time:Utc` value corresponding to the current UTC time

functions.name: monotonicNow
functions.description:
Returns the number of seconds from an unspecified epoch.
This API guarantees consistent value increase in subsequent calls with nanoseconds precision.
```ballerina
decimal seconds = time:monotonicNow();
```

return.description: The number of seconds from an unspecified epoch

functions.name: utcFromString
functions.description:
Converts an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g., `2007-12-03T10:15:30.00Z`) to UTC.
```ballerina
time:Utc|time:Error utc = time:utcFromString("2007-12-03T10:15:30.00Z");
```

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: The RFC 3339 timestamp as a string (e.g., `2007-12-03T10:15:30.00Z`)

return.description:
The corresponding `time:Utc` value or a `time:Error` when the specified timestamp
is not adhere to the RFC 3339 format (e.g., `2007-12-03T10:15:30.00Z`)

functions.name: utcToString
functions.description:
Converts a given UTC time to an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g., `2007-12-03T10:15:30.00Z`).
```ballerina
string utcString = time:utcToString(time:utcNow());
```

parameters.name: utc
parameters.description:
The UTC time as a tuple `[int, decimal]`, where the first element is the seconds from the epoch
and the second element is the fractional part of the last second.

return.description: The corresponding RFC 3339 timestamp string

functions.name: utcAddSeconds
functions.description:
Returns UTC time that occurs seconds after the given UTC time.
This assumes that all days have 86400 seconds except when UTC represents a time during a positive leap second,
in which case the corresponding day will be assumed to have 86401 seconds.
```ballerina
time:Utc utc = time:utcAddSeconds(time:utcNow(), 20.900);
```

parameters.name: utc
parameters.description:
The UTC time as a tuple `[int, decimal]`, where the first element is the seconds from the epoch
and the second element is the fractional part of the last second.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Number of seconds to be added. Can include fractional seconds (e.g., 20.900).

return.description: The resulting UTC time as a tuple `[int, decimal]` after adding the specified seconds.

functions.name: utcDiffSeconds

parameters.name: utc1

1st UTC time as a tuple `[int, decimal]`, where the first element is the seconds from the epoch

parameters.name: utc2
parameters.description:
2nd UTC time as a tuple `[int, decimal]`, where the first element is the seconds from the epoch

return.description: The difference between two UTC times in seconds

functions.name: utcToEmailString

parameters.name: utc
parameters.description:
The UTC time as a tuple `[int, decimal]`, where the first element is the seconds from the epoch
and the second element is the fractional part of the last second.

parameters.name: zh
parameters.description:
Specifies the type of the zone value to be added. Possible values include:
- `"0"`: Default zone handling
- `"GMT"`: Represents Greenwich Mean Time
- `"UT"`: Represents Universal Time
- `"Z"`: Represents the Zulu time zone (UTC+0)

return.description: The corresponding email-formatted string value

functions.name: civilFromEmailString
functions.description:
Converts a given RFC 5322 formatted string (e.g., `Wed, 10 Mar 2021 19:51:55 -0800 (PST)`) to a civil record.
```ballerina
time:Civil|time:Error emailDateTime = time:civilFromEmailString("Wed, 10 Mar 2021 19:51:55 -0820");
```

parameters.name: dateTimeString
parameters.description: The RFC 5322 formatted string to be converted (e.g., `Wed, 10 Mar 2021 19:51:55 -0800 (PST)`)

return.description: The corresponding `time:Civil` value or a `time:Error` if the given string is incorrectly formatted.

functions.name: civilToEmailString

parameters.name: civil
parameters.description: The `time:Civil` record to be converted

parameters.name: zoneHandling
parameters.description:
Specifies how to handle the zone. Possible values include:
- `PREFER_ZONE_OFFSET`: Use the zone offset for the output.
- `PREFER_TIME_ABBREV`: Use the time abbreviation for the output.
- `ZONE_OFFSET_WITH_TIME_ABBREV_COMMENT`: Use the zone offset and include the time abbreviation as a comment.

return.description: The RFC 5322 formatted string (e.g., `Wed, 10 Mar 2021 19:51:55 -0800 (PST)`) or an error if the civil record contains invalid parameters.

functions.name: civilAddDuration

parameters.name: civil
parameters.description: The civil record to which the duration should be added

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: The time duration to be added. This can include fields such as `years`, `months`, `days`, `hours`, `minutes`, and `seconds`

return.description: The updated civil record after adding the duration, or an error if the operation results in an invalid civil record

functions.name: loadSystemZone
functions.description:
Loads the default time zone of the system.
```ballerina
time:Zone|time:Error zone = time:loadSystemZone();
```

return.description: The system's default zone value or error when the zone ID of the system is in invalid format.

functions.name: getZone
functions.description:
Returns the time zone object for a given zone ID.
```ballerina
time:Zone? zone = time:getZone("Asia/Colombo");
```

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Time zone ID in the format of ("Continent/City")

return.description: Corresponding time zone object or `nil` if the zone ID is invalid or not found.
